137	   Read material producers, consumers and owners across that cone within the
138	   access grant; narrow write territory is not a narrower reasoning boundary.

153	   paths before claiming a candidate.

155	   provenance and validity apply. Function boundaries alone do not invalidate

162	   obligation, owner, purpose, scope and cost, and temporary ones a removal

168	   qualification, release, risk, or admitted-work law requires independence
169	   and separately activates `stdo-review`.

172	question, subject/basis, supporting computed evidence, actor and authority,
173	conclusion, scope, uncertainty and revising observation. Preserve the original
174	owner ruling separately from interpretation. Invalidate the affected claim
175	when its support changes; retain unrelated valid results. Reuse does not
176	manufacture an owner ruling or satisfy required independent assessment.
177	
178	On repricing, retain, supersede, defer or withdraw each affected obligation with
179	its owner/evidence links in this carrier. Present the short consequence delta;
180	"continue" does not accept an undisclosed architectural change. An authorized
181	preservation checkpoint can keep unfinished work with its predecessor,
182	territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence; it claims no
183	acceptance or publication.

186	valid supporting evidence, required judgments/rulings and absence of an active
187	non-closure condition. A review event is not completion. Record a satisfied
188	bounded result under the existing state-mutation grant; withhold only the
189	affected claim when a condition is missing. Qualification, publication and
190	consumer adoption retain their separate conditions.

196	proof, non-changes, residuals, and closed or withheld work result. Do not
197	claim acceptance beyond the grant, discard a surviving obligation, or silently

# Product Basis Selection

Use this read-only procedure before every STDO workflow skill. It selects and
verifies one Product basis; it grants no mutation, execution, review,
disposition, installation, or continuation authority.

## Procedure

1. State the requested Product scope from the exact request and Product-owned
   identities or claims. If the request does not distinguish the Product, keep
   the scope unresolved.
2. Discover candidate `stdo_<label>.json` definitions within the authorized
   workspace search boundary. A filename, current directory, nearest file, or
   directory nesting is discovery evidence only and cannot select a Product or
   imply composition.
3. Determine applicability from each definition's Product-definition identity
   and its Product-owned `what`, `how`, `ticketing`, bounded-context, and
   explicit composition bindings. A path is selecting evidence only when the
   definition itself binds it to the requested Product scope.
4. Require exactly one applicable definition. For zero applicable definitions,
   return the unresolved scope. For multiple applicable definitions, return
   every remaining definition identity and path and request Product-scope
   disambiguation. Do not choose by proximity, familiarity, recency, or label.
5. Verify the selected definition read-only:

   ```sh
   stdo status --definition <selected-definition> --verify
   ```

   Require the reported definition path and identity, immutable basis URI, and
   manifest SHA-256 to match the selected definition, with `installed: true`,
   `valid: true`, and no failures. Do not sync, adopt, install, fall back to
   mutable source, or select a nearby Product during this procedure.
6. Return the requested Product scope, definition identity and path, immutable
   basis URI or cut, manifest SHA-256, and verification result. Only then may
   the calling skill continue under its own effect and authority boundary.

Zero definitions, multiple applicable definitions, failed verification, or any
identity, path, basis, manifest, installation, or validity mismatch stops the
calling skill before effects. Report the exact candidates or mismatch and the
required re-entry; do not repair it implicitly.

53	## Agentic Construction Execution (`STDO-UP-020`)
54	
55	When construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker, the
56	method governs the execution relation without prescribing the worker's model,
57	prompt, tools, internal search, process topology, repository layout, or
58	orchestration runtime.
59	
60	The normative relation is:
61	
62	```text
63	accepted governing basis
64	  -> bounded affected relation set
65	  -> selected computational relations
66	  -> delegated execution and decision authority
67	  -> construction and self-review
68	  -> independent live-surface assessment where required
69	  -> accept | local repair | re-enter | reject
70	  -> exact accepted checkpoint
71	  -> next already-authorized bounded action
72	```
73	
74	### Sufficient Execution Intake
75	
76	A bounded action begins from an authority basis sufficient to reconstruct its
77	governing relations without conversation history, commentary, prior-worker
78	memory, or implementation folklore. The intake identifies:
79	
80	- the selected Product outcome, prerequisite, or admitted experiment;
81	- the bounded affected relation set and applicable governing invariants;
82	- accepted transformation-admission relations;
83	- selected computational or common-library dispositions;
84	- construction and assessment authority; and
85	- the conditions that require upstream re-entry.
86	
87	Where `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` applies, `STDO-UP-017` bounded-frame
88	conservation, `STDO-UP-016` transformation-admission completeness,
89	`STDO-UP-018` invariant-reconstruction sufficiency, and `STDO-UP-019`
90	computational-realization projection supply these design inputs. This section
91	consumes those laws; it does not create a second design package.
92	
93	### Bounded Causal Construction
94	
95	The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of
96	delivering working behavior while preserving every affected governing
97	relation. It need not coincide with one function, file, module, ticket field,
98	or design document.
99	
100	A seam whose far side can causally affect, or be affected by, the action is
101	inside the cone unless the basis establishes that it cannot participate.
102	Unrelated incompleteness outside the cone is recorded as repricing input and
103	does not block the bounded claim.
104	
105	### Construction, Assessment, And Delegation
106	
107	The constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review. Where independent
108	assessment supports promotion, the assessor evaluates the exact live code,
109	authority paths, proof, and installed subject rather than treating the
110	constructor's summary as sufficient evidence. This preserves the independent-
111	review relation; it does not prescribe an actor count. One actor may occupy
112	different roles across different claims when independence for the assessed
113	claim is preserved.
114	
115	The governing authority relation declares whether a bounded proxy may accept
116	and advance routine actions. A proxy may accept preservation, require local
117	repair, reject a violating candidate, and advance to the next already-
118	authorized action. It cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing
119	authority, or accepted design. Such a change re-enters at its owning relation.
120	
121	Human ceremony is not required at every transition when the governing basis,
122	affected cone, decision envelope, and re-entry conditions are already
123	accepted. This delegation does not weaken direct-human acceptance where
124	Product or release law requires it.
125	
126	When one capable context has sufficient existing work authority, exact intake
127	and operation grant, it may enter directly as constructor or Writer. No
128	Executive activation is required solely to appoint that Writer. The applicable
129	frame configuration selects coordination when material contexts, authority,
130	capability or required independence need it; a role or frame name alone does
131	not create that need. Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission,
132	the smallest lawful carrier, required assessment and reserved decisions. It
133	permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
134	at a boundary owned elsewhere.
135	
136	One bounded operation grant may cover its declared construction, status and
137	checkpoint sequence. Record actual role transitions in the existing work
138	carrier; a status change alone requires neither a new grant nor rehashing an
139	unchanged subject. A material change to the operation, subject, territory,
140	authority or validity conditions still requires the affected binding to be
141	resolved before effect. Executive mutation restrictions remain applicable.
142	
143	### Proportional Disposition
144	
145	Assessment returns one of these semantic dispositions:
146	
147	| Disposition | Condition |
148	|---|---|
149	| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation |
150	| `local_repair` | implementation or proof is locally defective while the governing relation remains coherent |
151	| `re_enter` | Product, requirement, identity, lifecycle, authority, public contract, or accepted design must change |
152	| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path |
153	
154	Global correctness means conserving every global relation affected by the
155	bounded action. It does not require proving the whole Product inside every
156	local action.
157	
158	Repeated rejection against one unchanged boundary requires reassessment of the
159	frame altitude, causal cone, common components, design-versus-code placement,
160	and authority sufficiency. The method sets no rejection-count threshold,
161	mandatory review-round count, or review state machine; it prohibits repeating
162	an unchanged failed construction relation as if iteration alone could close it.
163	
164	### Transition Evidence And Proof Cadence
165	
166	A reviewable transition identifies the exact candidate, affected relations,
167	changed realization paths, authority paths added or removed, retained and open
168	seams, focused proof, any required integration proof, explicit non-changes, and
169	the assessor disposition. Consumers choose the representation. Transition
170	evidence is a read model and does not become specification, design, or
171	admission authority.
172	
173	Construction uses the cheapest focused proof capable of falsifying the active
174	relation. Expensive whole-candidate qualification occurs at a declared
175	candidate boundary rather than after every local edit, unless the affected
176	risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary.
177	
178	A durable or reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a
179	same-process proof when loss of incidental process state is a material
180	counterexample. Proof must destroy or exclude the incidental authority and
181	compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.
182	
183	### Checkpoint, Continuation, Progress, And Churn
184	
185	Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint. The next already-authorized bounded
186	action may begin without renewed human approval; acceptance does not widen the
187	Product outcome or affected relation set.
188	
189	A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted work under an
190	existing exact operation grant. Identify its parent or predecessor, included
191	territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence location. It is
192	neither acceptance, promotion nor publication. A proposed restart identifies
193	why repair of retained work is insufficient, which obligations and evidence
194	survive, and which causal assumptions change; reconstructability alone does
195	not select reconstruction.
196	
197	Accepted material Product movement is progress. Prerequisite work names the
198	Product obligation it enables. Preservation and repeated proof are evidence,
199	not new progress. Rejected or superseded construction is churn. Discovery of
200	previously hidden distance revises the forecast but is not itself negative
201	implementation progress. Paperwork, code volume, test count, commit count, and
202	review count are not Product progress by themselves.
203	
204	These are semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm. Consumers may
205	derive their own progress and churn projections from them.
206	
207	This protocol is false if execution proceeds from unreconstructable context,
208	if a constructor's report substitutes for required independent live evidence,
209	if a bounded proxy changes a governing relation outside its delegation, if
210	unrelated incompleteness blocks a closed causal cone, if a same-process test is
211	used to prove materially cross-process authority, or if rejected activity is
212	reported as accepted Product progress.
213	
214	---
215	
216	
217	Source: [SPEC_METHOD.md — Computed Classification And Treatment](../SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment); SHA256 `4a0bdfc9591843353d34ba2530cff504b7891f157b2fd8e73f9e695bf34fdd87`.
218	
219	### Computed Classification And Treatment
220	
221	Intake supplies one reusable classification result rather than requiring each
222	role to reconstruct the same facts. `C` denotes reproducible facts and declared
223	rule application; `J` denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; `O`
224	denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. These annotations grant no
225	authority and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface, or
226	mandatory document.
227	
228	The explicitly selected source, worksite, or qualification capability produces
229	C over the exact request and desired outcome, known targets and effects,
230	operation grant and work lifetime, Product Definition and governing basis,
231	baseline and available candidate, declared relations, accepted design and
232	trace bindings, evidence, and applicable rules. Its output identifies the
233	producer and procedure revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes,
234	reproduction relation, unknowns and invalidators. Missing candidate or evidence
235	is an input state, not a claim that nothing changed.
236	
237	The computed result must expose:
238	
239	1. **Authority traversal.** Follow explicit source, ownership, dependency,
240	   composition and projection declarations from the affected targets and
241	   effects. Identify each reached layer and owner, its exact basis and
242	   changed/unchanged/unknown relation, the traversed edges, and the unresolved
243	   frontier. Include root, authority and grant changes even when Public bytes
244	   are equal. An absent edge does not prove irrelevance; undeclared or
245	   semantically uncertain materiality remains J.
246	2. **Public delta.** Enumerate the complete relevant serialized member universe
247	   under its owning declaration and applicable projection, including helper and
248	   generated dependencies. Report added and removed identities and every
249	   retained member with changed typed value or bytes, with exact before/after
250	   values. A rename is removal plus addition unless its owner supplies an
251	   identity-preserving relation. Missing candidate, incomplete enumeration,
252	   ambiguous identity or unavailable projection leaves the affected delta
253	   unknown; membership equality alone proves no value equality.
254	3. **Accepted-design coverage.** Join changed bytes and relations to explicit
255	   accepted scope, traces and acceptance evidence. Distinguish covered,
256	   missing, stale, ambiguous and outside-scope evidence. A filename, listed
257	   artifact or digest alone establishes no accepted coverage. Current trace
258	   coverage is a computed fact; residual semantic sufficiency remains J.
259	4. **Rule-determined treatment.** Apply only declared rules with sufficient

389	
390	## Complete Engagement Transition
391	
392	The following steps describe the coordinated branch selected under Engagement
393	Applicability. Direct Worker engagement preserves the same sufficient intake,
394	work-result algebra, closure conditions and owner boundaries without inserting
395	Executive appointment or a review that no applicable condition requires.
396	
397	### 1. Existing Authority Selects The Basis
398	
399	Goals, Product, requirements, accepted design, ticket, release, or an admitted
400	bounded proxy selects the outcome and work authority under its existing STDO
401	owner. The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis projects that decision.
402	
403	### 2. Executive Activates Worker
404	
405	In the coordinated branch, Executive applies `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md`
406	activation to the `STDO-UP-020` sufficient execution intake. The activation identifies:
407	
408	- selected complete STDO and project authority;
409	- exact governed outcome and checkpoint;
410	- affected causal relation set and governing invariants;
411	- selected computational relations and specialist frames;
412	- testing claims, exact subjects, frame topology, material combination
413	  populations, ordinary paths, oracles, and forbidden-path exclusions where
414	  testing evidence is required;
415	- Worker authority, capability envelope, and the exact inherited operation
416	  grant, subject, and write territory where mutation is authorized;
417	- evidence and qualification obligations;
418	- exclusions, prohibited competing paths, stop conditions, and re-entry
419	  conditions; and
420	- the exact bounded action already authorized.
421	
422	If activation detects a known capability, authority, subject, basis, or
423	topology mismatch, it returns `activation_refusal` directly to Executive. No
424	Worker frame is active, no Worker evaluation occurs, and Executive must not
425	manufacture a Worker result to represent the failed activation.
426	
427	### 3. Worker Returns To Executive
428	
429	Every coordinated Worker activation terminates in one closed work result sent
430	to Executive. Direct work uses its declared result consumer:
431	
432	```text
433	WorkerResult
434	  = candidate_ready(exact_subject, transition_evidence, residuals)
435	  | refused(reason, authority, evidence)
436	  | incomplete(residuals, evidence, stop_basis)
437	  | re_entry_requested(owner, material_relation, evidence)
438	```
439	
440	The notation is explanatory and mandates no schema.
441	
442	Each variant accompanies exactly one Reference Frame Method result under the
443	mapping in `Work result`: `satisfied -> candidate_ready`, `falsified ->
444	refused`, `indeterminate -> incomplete`, and `out_of_frame | invalid_basis ->
445	re_entry_requested`. The mapping applies only after lawful activation.
446	
447	The Worker does not send a candidate directly into an implicitly active
448	Reviewer. It stops after returning the result.
449	
450	### 4. Executive Evaluates The Work Result
451	
452	For `refused`, `incomplete`, or `re_entry_requested`, the Executive verifies
453	the exact basis and applies the existing authority relation. It records the
454	applicable `STDO-UP-020` disposition or reactivates work only when the current
455	authority already permits that action. None of these variants can be treated as
456	accepted progress merely because work occurred.
457	
458	For `candidate_ready`, the Executive verifies the exact subject and determines
459	whether independent assessment is required by `STDO-UP-007`,
460	`STDO-UP-020`, `STDO-UP-022`, Product, release, risk, or the admitted work
461	contract. Green aggregate status cannot satisfy this step when a required
462	user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration, unit, or negative-path result is
463	missing, bound to another subject, or contradicted by a material frame result.
464	
465	### 5A. Candidate Does Not Require Independent Review
466	
467	In the coordinated branch, when independent review is not required, Executive
468	consumes the exact candidate, Worker self-review, transition evidence, and any mandatory
469	specialist-frame results. It applies `STDO-UP-020` disposition within its
470	decision envelope.
471	
472	Self-review remains Worker evidence. The disposition does not relabel it as
473	independent.
474	
475	### 5B. Candidate Requires Independent Review
476	
477	When independent review is required, the Executive activates the Reviewer with:
478	
479	- exact candidate and governing basis;
480	- exact claim, composition boundary, population, scope, and exclusions;
481	- applicable STDO and project authority;
482	- required evidence and ordinary assurance path;
483	- required user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration, unit, combinatorial, and
484	  negative-path frame results with their exact claims and populations;
485	- the Product-selected severity scale and exact affected Product claims;
486	- Reviewer capability and independence envelope; and
487	- invalidation and stop conditions.
488	
489	The candidate is frozen before material reference exposure where
490	`STDO-UP-022` requires it. Otherwise the subject is stabilized to the exactness
491	required by `STDO-UP-007`, `STDO-UP-020`, and the claim.
492	
493	### 6. Reviewer Returns To Executive
494	
495	The Reviewer returns one closed evaluation containing:
496	
497	- frame and activation identity;
498	- exact subject, basis, claim, scope, exclusions, and evaluated population;
499	- Reviewer actor and independence conditions;
500	- evidence and ordinary assurance path acquired;
501	- Reference Frame Method result;
502	- findings, counterexamples, and adjacent observations;
503	- for each finding, affected claim, severity, causal assessment and confidence,
504	  blast radius, workaround, repair complexity, regression risk, and residual
505	  uncertainty where supportable; and
506	- invalidation conditions and re-entry owner where applicable.
507	
508	### Reviewer Result And Triage Projection
509	
510	The Reviewer payload projection is total across the Reference Frame Method
511	result algebra. `complete`, `indeterminate`, and `not_applicable` below classify
512	the finding-level triage payload; they are not new evaluation results,
513	dispositions, priorities, or lifecycle states.
514	
515	| Reference Frame Method result | Finding and triage payload | Executive consumption constraint |
516	|---|---|---|
517	| `satisfied` | explicit no-finding state; triage `not_applicable`; evidence, residuals, and invalidation remain present | priority and current-boundary effect are `not_applicable` to this review result unless another exact consumed result supplies a finding |
518	| `falsified` | one or more exact findings; triage is `complete` where supported and preserves `indeterminate` fields where evidence cannot close them | apply Product-owned priority and boundary policy without mechanically mapping severity to disposition |
519	| `indeterminate` | partial finding or observation state; triage `indeterminate`; exact evidence gaps and residual uncertainty | retain uncertainty or reactivate a capable evaluation; do not consume it as satisfaction or a closed finding |
520	| `out_of_frame` | the evaluated claim requires an undeclared material relation or evaluator capability; triage `indeterminate`; name the missing relation or capability and exact reconfiguration pressure | refine or reconfigure a capable activation and retain the claim as unresolved; do not consume the result as satisfaction or falsification |
521	| `invalid_basis` | basis failure; triage `not_applicable`; invalidation evidence and basis-repair pressure | refuse result consumption and return through the declared basis re-entry relation |
522	
523	An adjacent observation outside the evaluated claim does not replace the
524	claim-relative result. Reviewer returns it separately with triage
525	`not_applicable` to that claim and exact repricing or re-entry pressure. The
526	Executive returns it to its declared owner without creating a claim-relative
527	block or another review round from severity alone.
528	
529	The Reviewer returns to Executive, not Worker. It does not edit the candidate,
530	direct the repair, or authorize continuation.
531	
532	### 7. Executive Disposes And Checkpoints
533	
534	The Executive verifies that every consumed result remains bound to the current
535	subject and basis, revalidates the complete Product view and current MVP or
536	release mandate, applies any declared result conjunction, assigns priority,
537	records the effect on the current promotion boundary, and acts on exactly one
538	`STDO-UP-020` disposition within its grant:
539	
540	- `accept`;
541	- `local_repair`;
542	- `re_enter`; or
543	- `reject`.
544	
545	`STDO-UP-020` remains the owner of each disposition, exact accepted checkpoint,
546	and next already-authorized bounded action. A repair creates a new candidate.
547	An affected review is reactivated against that candidate. Acceptance does not
548	widen the Product outcome or authorize an unselected successor.
549	
550	Severity does not mechanically select priority or block promotion. Priority
551	does not erase severity or waive a hard stop. The Executive determines blocking
552	from the exact affected claim, current mandate, applicable hard stops, and
553	Product-owned cutoff policy. An unsupported technical assessment is returned
554	through a new or refined activation rather than silently rewritten.
555	
556	### Executive Promotion Constraint Projection
557	
558	| Consumed condition | Required Executive constraint |
559	|---|---|
560	| valid falsification of a mandatory claim governed by a non-waivable hard stop | current promotion boundary blocks regardless of assigned priority or decision cutoff |
561	| valid finding below the Product-owned decision cutoff with no hard stop | no mechanical block follows; apply the Product-owned policy and retain any accepted residual explicitly |
562	| observation outside the exact evaluated claim | treat as bounded repricing or re-entry input; do not create a claim-relative block or another review round by severity label |
563	| unsupported or materially incomplete technical assessment | reactivate a capable evaluation or retain `indeterminate`; do not rewrite Reviewer evidence |
564	
565	---
566	
567	
568	Source: [TICKET_METHOD.md — Execution And Verification Authority Separation (`STDO-UP-007`)](../TICKET_METHOD.md#execution-and-verification-authority-separation-stdo-up-007); SHA256 `2cbdc039c0a9033cb541a8b63d90da11a35923ea89ebe2d3132ffa7ddfb84417`.
569	
570	### Execution And Verification Authority Separation (`STDO-UP-007`)
571	
572	Authority to author or implement a change is not independent authority to
573	verify it. Where independent review is required, the reviewer is not the author
574	of the reviewed subject and identifies the exact subject, basis, scope,
575	exclusions, evidence, verdict, and unresolved findings.
576	
577	Self-review remains useful authoring evidence but cannot be relabeled as
578	independent. Human authority may accept or reject the claim; it does not make
579	implementer self-review independent. Independent review is required at Product,
580	qualification, release, and explicitly risk-bearing boundaries that claim it,
581	not for every local implementation step.
582	
583	A claimed independent review may support promotion or closure only when its
584	exact subject and verdict are durably traceable through an existing ticket,
585	commentary, qualification, or release-evidence carrier. A statement that review
586	occurred, an unbound conversation summary, or an unavailable draft is not the
587	review verdict. This rule requires no separate receipt, carrier, or review
588	round.
589	
590	A review verdict is bounded by the exact reviewed claim and its applicable hard
591	stops. A finding blocks current promotion only when it falsifies that claim,
592	exposes competing or ambiguous authority on its acceptance path, violates
593	applicable active authority, safety, or retained accepted behavior, or
594	establishes a material architectural decision with durable consequences that
595	forecloses an admitted Product outcome.
596	
597	A valid observation outside that boundary is repricing input. It does not by
598	itself widen the reviewed subject, block its bounded claim, or require a new
599	ticket, artifact, review round, or implementation increment.
600	
601	A direct or lawfully proxied human ruling receives durable disposition before
602	the next affected acceptance boundary. Its source wording remains distinct
603	from agent interpretation. Opening a ticket records the obligation but does not
604	satisfy it, and an agent cannot widen the ruling while recording it.
605	
606	Where `SPEC_METHOD.md`'s Agentic Construction Execution relation applies, the
607	active work item identifies the selected execution basis, bounded affected
608	relation set, delegated construction and assessment authority, and re-entry
609	conditions. It may point to accepted design and existing evidence carriers
610	rather than restating them. Ticket state, ticket prose, or an admitted execution
611	contract cannot widen that basis or substitute for the live-surface assessment
612	required by the protocol.
613	
614	The reviewable transition may be carried by an existing ticket, commentary,
615	commit, qualification, or release-evidence surface. No new ticket state,
616	document type, review round, or approval ceremony is required. Ticket Method
617	carries selection and traceability; `SPEC_METHOD.md` owns the execution
618	semantics.
619	
620	
621	Source: [TICKET_METHOD.md — Condition-Based Closure And Reuse](../TICKET_METHOD.md#condition-based-closure-and-reuse); SHA256 `2cbdc039c0a9033cb541a8b63d90da11a35923ea89ebe2d3132ffa7ddfb84417`.
622	
623	### Condition-Based Closure And Reuse
624	
625	A work claim is complete only when every applicable declared obligation is
626	satisfied by valid evidence for its exact subject, basis and scope, all required
627	judgments and owner rulings are present and applicable, and no active
628	non-closure condition remains. A mandatory but unknown applicability or
629	insufficient-evidence result withholds the dependent claim; evidence presence
630	alone is not satisfaction. The existing owner decides any reserved acceptance.
631	
632	Review evaluates these conditions; its occurrence is not the closing event.
633	Where applicable law requires no independent review or reserved acceptance,
634	the authorized Writer may record the satisfied bounded result in the existing
635	carrier without adding a ticket, Executive appointment, review or design-view
636	recreation solely to mark completion. This does not waive a condition that
637	actually applies, including sprint-close or design-method law.
638	
639	An unchanged obligation reuses valid applicable evidence and recorded J/O.
640	A material counterexample, changed evidence or basis invalidates the affected
641	claim and its dependent results before further reliance. An unrelated
642	observation is retained as bounded repricing input; it does not reopen a
643	satisfied claim or expand work automatically. Closure recording preserves the
644	exact evaluated scope, satisfied conditions, evidence and remaining residuals.
645	
646	
647	Source: [REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md — RF-005 Exact Basis And Coordinates](../REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#rf-005-exact-basis-and-coordinates); SHA256 `44bb25eacd05550240d31ef318dc2c23db2b8a147ba1b8daa342f688d343e488`.
648	
649	### RF-005 Exact Basis And Coordinates
650	
651	Every result binds its exact subject, basis, coordinates, and evidence scope.
652	A stale, advanced, ambiguous, or mismatched basis returns `invalid_basis` or
653	requires reactivation. Apparent equality does not substitute for declared
654	coordinate equality.
655	
656	
657	Source: [REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md — RF-014 Capability Fit](../REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#rf-014-capability-fit); SHA256 `44bb25eacd05550240d31ef318dc2c23db2b8a147ba1b8daa342f688d343e488`.
658	
659	### RF-014 Capability Fit
660	
661	Frame adequacy includes actor usability. When the material manifold exceeds an
662	actor's capability envelope, human authority may select another actor, refine
663	the frame, sequence activations, or provide a lawful compression. The actor may
664	not silently omit material relations to fit context.

# Bounded Work and Recovery Frame

This non-deciding view contains exact owner excerpts, not a Project Reference-Frame
Basis, activation grant or universal workflow. The separate activation binds
the current task, subject, actor, sufficient material and existing authority.
Every excerpt keeps its source adoption, independence, result, frontier, closure
and proof conditions. A digest-bound view conveys no operation or acceptance
authority; changed source pins require refresh or supported applicability.

This selection makes no material-sufficiency claim. Its separate activation and
the source owners determine required coupled material and any lawful response
to insufficient capability; this preface supplies no response or selection grant.








Source: [TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md — Work/recovery specialization](../TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#workrecovery-specialization); SHA256 `48d17db3b805661947474009d06135c0ba33dedbdd48759cfc5c0631be8f8507`.

## Work/recovery specialization

This chain specializes the generic contract for interrupted, purposeful work.
It assumes an admitted work identity, persistent workspace, selected outcome,
actual grants and a material uncertain effect. These are explicit instance
premises; they do not follow from finite capacity alone.

| Premises | Conditional consequence | Particular contract and independent choice |
|---|---|---|
| F1, F2; selected outcome and current subject | A current claim needs its actual predicate and support, not a remembered green status. | Spec Method UP-020 binds target truth and checkpoint; RF-005 fixes basis/coordinates. The owner chooses the outcome. |
| F2, F5; coupled material obligations and finite actor | Acquire sufficient material or return the admitted uncertainty; omitted support cannot become satisfaction. | RF-003/RF-014 bind sufficiency/capability; the work entry locates a responsibility view. Frame selection and configuration authority remain independent grants. |
| F3, F4; persistent work and affected dependencies | Re-enter on observed current state, retaining applicable progress and reconsidering changed support. | Computed Classification And Treatment and Ticket condition-based reuse choose applicability, invalidation and the wider frontier when independence is unproved. Their concrete freshness rules are domain policy. |
| F2, F3, F6; an effect is uncertain and repetition could duplicate it | Neither historical intent nor a timeout proves completion or grants a safe repeat. Observe/reconcile, select another permitted action, or return unresolved. | Computed Classification And Treatment supplies the unknown-effect rule; the operation grant supplies allowed observation and repair. Idempotence must be established for the actual operation. |
| F1, F4, F6; required results and current mandate | Preserve failures, uncovered obligations and uncertainty; choose only an already-authorized continuation or truthful stop. | UP-020, declared conjunction and any adopted Baseline engagement specialize evaluation/disposition. Independence, decision rule and role adoption are additional owner choices. |

The consequences are arguments about the stated premises, not proofs of every
source clause. Concrete work-carrier layout, number of actors, numeric budgets,
optional Baseline adoption, release procedure and all domain result enums are
independent choices. They are not inferred from the foundational commitments.
This chain leaves those choices at their owners and adds no mandatory ledger.

A recovery activation uses the sufficient projected clauses and actual subject.
It need not load this entire argument, every method or historical event bodies.
The [ordinary work entry](../../plugins/spec/skills/stdo-work/SKILL.md#acquire-the-responsibility-frame)
locates that material after basis selection. Its projection does not become a
rival authority or guarantee sufficiency for a different task.


Source: [SPEC_METHOD.md — Agentic Construction Execution (`STDO-UP-020`)](../SPEC_METHOD.md#agentic-construction-execution-stdo-up-020); SHA256 `4a0bdfc9591843353d34ba2530cff504b7891f157b2fd8e73f9e695bf34fdd87`.

## Agentic Construction Execution (`STDO-UP-020`)

When construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker, the
method governs the execution relation without prescribing the worker's model,
prompt, tools, internal search, process topology, repository layout, or
orchestration runtime.

The normative relation is:

```text
accepted governing basis
  -> bounded affected relation set
  -> selected computational relations
  -> delegated execution and decision authority
  -> construction and self-review
  -> independent live-surface assessment where required
  -> accept | local repair | re-enter | reject
  -> exact accepted checkpoint
  -> next already-authorized bounded action
```

### Sufficient Execution Intake

A bounded action begins from an authority basis sufficient to reconstruct its
governing relations without conversation history, commentary, prior-worker
memory, or implementation folklore. The intake identifies:

- the selected Product outcome, prerequisite, or admitted experiment;
- the bounded affected relation set and applicable governing invariants;
- accepted transformation-admission relations;
- selected computational or common-library dispositions;
- construction and assessment authority; and
- the conditions that require upstream re-entry.

Where `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` applies, `STDO-UP-017` bounded-frame
conservation, `STDO-UP-016` transformation-admission completeness,
`STDO-UP-018` invariant-reconstruction sufficiency, and `STDO-UP-019`
computational-realization projection supply these design inputs. This section
consumes those laws; it does not create a second design package.

### Bounded Causal Construction

The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of
delivering working behavior while preserving every affected governing
relation. It need not coincide with one function, file, module, ticket field,
or design document.

A seam whose far side can causally affect, or be affected by, the action is
inside the cone unless the basis establishes that it cannot participate.
Unrelated incompleteness outside the cone is recorded as repricing input and
does not block the bounded claim.

### Construction, Assessment, And Delegation

The constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review. Where independent
assessment supports promotion, the assessor evaluates the exact live code,
authority paths, proof, and installed subject rather than treating the
constructor's summary as sufficient evidence. This preserves the independent-
review relation; it does not prescribe an actor count. One actor may occupy
different roles across different claims when independence for the assessed
claim is preserved.

The governing authority relation declares whether a bounded proxy may accept
and advance routine actions. A proxy may accept preservation, require local
repair, reject a violating candidate, and advance to the next already-
authorized action. It cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing
authority, or accepted design. Such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

Human ceremony is not required at every transition when the governing basis,
affected cone, decision envelope, and re-entry conditions are already
accepted. This delegation does not weaken direct-human acceptance where
Product or release law requires it.

When one capable context has sufficient existing work authority, exact intake
and operation grant, it may enter directly as constructor or Writer. No
Executive activation is required solely to appoint that Writer. The applicable
frame configuration selects coordination when material contexts, authority,
capability or required independence need it; a role or frame name alone does
not create that need. Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission,
the smallest lawful carrier, required assessment and reserved decisions. It
permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
at a boundary owned elsewhere.

One bounded operation grant may cover its declared construction, status and
checkpoint sequence. Record actual role transitions in the existing work
carrier; a status change alone requires neither a new grant nor rehashing an
unchanged subject. A material change to the operation, subject, territory,
authority or validity conditions still requires the affected binding to be
resolved before effect. Executive mutation restrictions remain applicable.

### Proportional Disposition

Assessment returns one of these semantic dispositions:

| Disposition | Condition |
|---|---|
| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation |
| `local_repair` | implementation or proof is locally defective while the governing relation remains coherent |
| `re_enter` | Product, requirement, identity, lifecycle, authority, public contract, or accepted design must change |
| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path |

Global correctness means conserving every global relation affected by the
bounded action. It does not require proving the whole Product inside every
local action.

Repeated rejection against one unchanged boundary requires reassessment of the
frame altitude, causal cone, common components, design-versus-code placement,
and authority sufficiency. The method sets no rejection-count threshold,
mandatory review-round count, or review state machine; it prohibits repeating
an unchanged failed construction relation as if iteration alone could close it.

### Transition Evidence And Proof Cadence

A reviewable transition identifies the exact candidate, affected relations,
changed realization paths, authority paths added or removed, retained and open
seams, focused proof, any required integration proof, explicit non-changes, and
the assessor disposition. Consumers choose the representation. Transition
evidence is a read model and does not become specification, design, or
admission authority.

Construction uses the cheapest focused proof capable of falsifying the active
relation. Expensive whole-candidate qualification occurs at a declared
candidate boundary rather than after every local edit, unless the affected
risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary.

A durable or reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a
same-process proof when loss of incidental process state is a material
counterexample. Proof must destroy or exclude the incidental authority and
compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.

### Checkpoint, Continuation, Progress, And Churn

Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint. The next already-authorized bounded
action may begin without renewed human approval; acceptance does not widen the
Product outcome or affected relation set.

A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted work under an
existing exact operation grant. Identify its parent or predecessor, included
territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence location. It is
neither acceptance, promotion nor publication. A proposed restart identifies
why repair of retained work is insufficient, which obligations and evidence
survive, and which causal assumptions change; reconstructability alone does
not select reconstruction.

Accepted material Product movement is progress. Prerequisite work names the
Product obligation it enables. Preservation and repeated proof are evidence,
not new progress. Rejected or superseded construction is churn. Discovery of
previously hidden distance revises the forecast but is not itself negative
implementation progress. Paperwork, code volume, test count, commit count, and
review count are not Product progress by themselves.

These are semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm. Consumers may
derive their own progress and churn projections from them.

This protocol is false if execution proceeds from unreconstructable context,
if a constructor's report substitutes for required independent live evidence,
if a bounded proxy changes a governing relation outside its delegation, if
unrelated incompleteness blocks a closed causal cone, if a same-process test is
used to prove materially cross-process authority, or if rejected activity is
reported as accepted Product progress.

### Computed Classification And Treatment

Intake supplies one reusable classification result rather than requiring each
role to reconstruct the same facts. `C` denotes reproducible facts and declared
rule application; `J` denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; `O`
denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. These annotations grant no
authority and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface, or
mandatory document.

The explicitly selected source, worksite, or qualification capability produces
C over the exact request and desired outcome, known targets and effects,
operation grant and work lifetime, Product Definition and governing basis,
baseline and available candidate, declared relations, accepted design and
trace bindings, evidence, and applicable rules. Its output identifies the
producer and procedure revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes,
reproduction relation, unknowns and invalidators. Missing candidate or evidence
is an input state, not a claim that nothing changed.

The computed result must expose:

1. **Authority traversal.** Follow explicit source, ownership, dependency,
   composition and projection declarations from the affected targets and
   effects. Identify each reached layer and owner, its exact basis and
   changed/unchanged/unknown relation, the traversed edges, and the unresolved
   frontier. Include root, authority and grant changes even when Public bytes
   are equal. An absent edge does not prove irrelevance; undeclared or
   semantically uncertain materiality remains J.
2. **Public delta.** Enumerate the complete relevant serialized member universe
   under its owning declaration and applicable projection, including helper and
   generated dependencies. Report added and removed identities and every
   retained member with changed typed value or bytes, with exact before/after
   values. A rename is removal plus addition unless its owner supplies an
   identity-preserving relation. Missing candidate, incomplete enumeration,
   ambiguous identity or unavailable projection leaves the affected delta
   unknown; membership equality alone proves no value equality.
3. **Accepted-design coverage.** Join changed bytes and relations to explicit
   accepted scope, traces and acceptance evidence. Distinguish covered,
   missing, stale, ambiguous and outside-scope evidence. A filename, listed
   artifact or digest alone establishes no accepted coverage. Current trace
   coverage is a computed fact; residual semantic sufficiency remains J.
4. **Rule-determined treatment.** Apply only declared rules with sufficient
   input facts, recording their owners, matched predicates and consequences.
   Expose the smallest lawful re-entry, next action, applicable evidence or
   assessment, reserved ruling and carrier lifetime, with any conflict or
   missing premise still unresolved. A label or filename cannot select the
   route. When rules settle the question, invent no residual judgment.

A Public delta or other nonconformance does not itself require changing the
governing contract. If that contract remains sufficient for the authorized
outcome, reject or locally repair the candidate within its grant. Re-enter
the actual governing owner when the explicitly selected desired outcome
requires changed meaning or an applicable assessment establishes governing
insufficiency. C determines that consequence only from sufficient declared
premises; unresolved intended meaning or necessity is J and any reserved
decision remains O. Candidate behavior cannot author its own target law.

Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance or promotion, not unrelated
authorized work. An existing bounded construction or evidence grant may permit
the cheapest useful discriminator, including obtaining the first candidate,
without asserting that the candidate is conformant. It carries its own exact subject,
territory, operations and stop conditions. Update the affected C result before
dependent effects or promotion rely on newly available evidence. Correct a
mistaken route at its smallest affected owner; preserve the original cause,
attempted subject, observed effect state and valid progress. Retry requires
the applicable outcome, authority and safe-recovery conditions; an unknown
effect state cannot be silently treated as no effect.

A new role, conversation or resumption reuses valid C after checking exact
applicability. Changed request, candidate, basis, owner/root relation,
projection, design trace/acceptance, rule, configuration or material evidence
invalidates its affected claims before reliance. Preserve predecessor and
successor identities, changed inputs, surviving facts and affected J
dependencies; recompute the wider frontier where independence is unproved.
`TICKET_METHOD.md` owns the existing carrier and recorded-J/O continuity rules.

## Complete Engagement Transition

The following steps describe the coordinated branch selected under Engagement
Applicability. Direct Worker engagement preserves the same sufficient intake,
work-result algebra, closure conditions and owner boundaries without inserting
Executive appointment or a review that no applicable condition requires.

### 1. Existing Authority Selects The Basis

Goals, Product, requirements, accepted design, ticket, release, or an admitted
bounded proxy selects the outcome and work authority under its existing STDO
owner. The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis projects that decision.

### 2. Executive Activates Worker

In the coordinated branch, Executive applies `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md`
activation to the `STDO-UP-020` sufficient execution intake. The activation identifies:

- selected complete STDO and project authority;
- exact governed outcome and checkpoint;
- affected causal relation set and governing invariants;
- selected computational relations and specialist frames;
- testing claims, exact subjects, frame topology, material combination
  populations, ordinary paths, oracles, and forbidden-path exclusions where
  testing evidence is required;
- Worker authority, capability envelope, and the exact inherited operation
  grant, subject, and write territory where mutation is authorized;
- evidence and qualification obligations;
- exclusions, prohibited competing paths, stop conditions, and re-entry
  conditions; and
- the exact bounded action already authorized.

If activation detects a known capability, authority, subject, basis, or
topology mismatch, it returns `activation_refusal` directly to Executive. No
Worker frame is active, no Worker evaluation occurs, and Executive must not
manufacture a Worker result to represent the failed activation.

### 3. Worker Returns To Executive

Every coordinated Worker activation terminates in one closed work result sent
to Executive. Direct work uses its declared result consumer:

```text
WorkerResult
  = candidate_ready(exact_subject, transition_evidence, residuals)
  | refused(reason, authority, evidence)
  | incomplete(residuals, evidence, stop_basis)
  | re_entry_requested(owner, material_relation, evidence)
```

The notation is explanatory and mandates no schema.

Each variant accompanies exactly one Reference Frame Method result under the
mapping in `Work result`: `satisfied -> candidate_ready`, `falsified ->
refused`, `indeterminate -> incomplete`, and `out_of_frame | invalid_basis ->
re_entry_requested`. The mapping applies only after lawful activation.

The Worker does not send a candidate directly into an implicitly active
Reviewer. It stops after returning the result.

### 4. Executive Evaluates The Work Result

For `refused`, `incomplete`, or `re_entry_requested`, the Executive verifies
the exact basis and applies the existing authority relation. It records the
applicable `STDO-UP-020` disposition or reactivates work only when the current
authority already permits that action. None of these variants can be treated as
accepted progress merely because work occurred.

For `candidate_ready`, the Executive verifies the exact subject and determines
whether independent assessment is required by `STDO-UP-007`,
`STDO-UP-020`, `STDO-UP-022`, Product, release, risk, or the admitted work
contract. Green aggregate status cannot satisfy this step when a required
user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration, unit, or negative-path result is
missing, bound to another subject, or contradicted by a material frame result.

### 5A. Candidate Does Not Require Independent Review

In the coordinated branch, when independent review is not required, Executive
consumes the exact candidate, Worker self-review, transition evidence, and any mandatory
specialist-frame results. It applies `STDO-UP-020` disposition within its
decision envelope.

Self-review remains Worker evidence. The disposition does not relabel it as
independent.

### 5B. Candidate Requires Independent Review

When independent review is required, the Executive activates the Reviewer with:

- exact candidate and governing basis;
- exact claim, composition boundary, population, scope, and exclusions;
- applicable STDO and project authority;
- required evidence and ordinary assurance path;
- required user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration, unit, combinatorial, and
  negative-path frame results with their exact claims and populations;
- the Product-selected severity scale and exact affected Product claims;
- Reviewer capability and independence envelope; and
- invalidation and stop conditions.

The candidate is frozen before material reference exposure where
`STDO-UP-022` requires it. Otherwise the subject is stabilized to the exactness
required by `STDO-UP-007`, `STDO-UP-020`, and the claim.

### 6. Reviewer Returns To Executive

The Reviewer returns one closed evaluation containing:

- frame and activation identity;
- exact subject, basis, claim, scope, exclusions, and evaluated population;
- Reviewer actor and independence conditions;
- evidence and ordinary assurance path acquired;
- Reference Frame Method result;
- findings, counterexamples, and adjacent observations;
- for each finding, affected claim, severity, causal assessment and confidence,
  blast radius, workaround, repair complexity, regression risk, and residual
  uncertainty where supportable; and
- invalidation conditions and re-entry owner where applicable.

### Reviewer Result And Triage Projection

The Reviewer payload projection is total across the Reference Frame Method
result algebra. `complete`, `indeterminate`, and `not_applicable` below classify
the finding-level triage payload; they are not new evaluation results,
dispositions, priorities, or lifecycle states.

| Reference Frame Method result | Finding and triage payload | Executive consumption constraint |
|---|---|---|
| `satisfied` | explicit no-finding state; triage `not_applicable`; evidence, residuals, and invalidation remain present | priority and current-boundary effect are `not_applicable` to this review result unless another exact consumed result supplies a finding |
| `falsified` | one or more exact findings; triage is `complete` where supported and preserves `indeterminate` fields where evidence cannot close them | apply Product-owned priority and boundary policy without mechanically mapping severity to disposition |
| `indeterminate` | partial finding or observation state; triage `indeterminate`; exact evidence gaps and residual uncertainty | retain uncertainty or reactivate a capable evaluation; do not consume it as satisfaction or a closed finding |
| `out_of_frame` | the evaluated claim requires an undeclared material relation or evaluator capability; triage `indeterminate`; name the missing relation or capability and exact reconfiguration pressure | refine or reconfigure a capable activation and retain the claim as unresolved; do not consume the result as satisfaction or falsification |
| `invalid_basis` | basis failure; triage `not_applicable`; invalidation evidence and basis-repair pressure | refuse result consumption and return through the declared basis re-entry relation |

An adjacent observation outside the evaluated claim does not replace the
claim-relative result. Reviewer returns it separately with triage
`not_applicable` to that claim and exact repricing or re-entry pressure. The
Executive returns it to its declared owner without creating a claim-relative
block or another review round from severity alone.

The Reviewer returns to Executive, not Worker. It does not edit the candidate,
direct the repair, or authorize continuation.

### 7. Executive Disposes And Checkpoints

The Executive verifies that every consumed result remains bound to the current
subject and basis, revalidates the complete Product view and current MVP or
release mandate, applies any declared result conjunction, assigns priority,
records the effect on the current promotion boundary, and acts on exactly one
`STDO-UP-020` disposition within its grant:

- `accept`;
- `local_repair`;
- `re_enter`; or
- `reject`.

`STDO-UP-020` remains the owner of each disposition, exact accepted checkpoint,
and next already-authorized bounded action. A repair creates a new candidate.
An affected review is reactivated against that candidate. Acceptance does not
widen the Product outcome or authorize an unselected successor.

Severity does not mechanically select priority or block promotion. Priority
does not erase severity or waive a hard stop. The Executive determines blocking
from the exact affected claim, current mandate, applicable hard stops, and
Product-owned cutoff policy. An unsupported technical assessment is returned
through a new or refined activation rather than silently rewritten.

### Executive Promotion Constraint Projection

| Consumed condition | Required Executive constraint |
|---|---|
| valid falsification of a mandatory claim governed by a non-waivable hard stop | current promotion boundary blocks regardless of assigned priority or decision cutoff |
| valid finding below the Product-owned decision cutoff with no hard stop | no mechanical block follows; apply the Product-owned policy and retain any accepted residual explicitly |
| observation outside the exact evaluated claim | treat as bounded repricing or re-entry input; do not create a claim-relative block or another review round by severity label |
| unsupported or materially incomplete technical assessment | reactivate a capable evaluation or retain `indeterminate`; do not rewrite Reviewer evidence |

### Execution And Verification Authority Separation (`STDO-UP-007`)

Authority to author or implement a change is not independent authority to
verify it. Where independent review is required, the reviewer is not the author
of the reviewed subject and identifies the exact subject, basis, scope,
exclusions, evidence, verdict, and unresolved findings.

Self-review remains useful authoring evidence but cannot be relabeled as
independent. Human authority may accept or reject the claim; it does not make
implementer self-review independent. Independent review is required at Product,
qualification, release, and explicitly risk-bearing boundaries that claim it,
not for every local implementation step.

A claimed independent review may support promotion or closure only when its
exact subject and verdict are durably traceable through an existing ticket,
commentary, qualification, or release-evidence carrier. A statement that review
occurred, an unbound conversation summary, or an unavailable draft is not the
review verdict. This rule requires no separate receipt, carrier, or review
round.

A review verdict is bounded by the exact reviewed claim and its applicable hard
stops. A finding blocks current promotion only when it falsifies that claim,
exposes competing or ambiguous authority on its acceptance path, violates
applicable active authority, safety, or retained accepted behavior, or
establishes a material architectural decision with durable consequences that
forecloses an admitted Product outcome.

A valid observation outside that boundary is repricing input. It does not by
itself widen the reviewed subject, block its bounded claim, or require a new
ticket, artifact, review round, or implementation increment.

A direct or lawfully proxied human ruling receives durable disposition before
the next affected acceptance boundary. Its source wording remains distinct
from agent interpretation. Opening a ticket records the obligation but does not
satisfy it, and an agent cannot widen the ruling while recording it.

Where `SPEC_METHOD.md`'s Agentic Construction Execution relation applies, the
active work item identifies the selected execution basis, bounded affected
relation set, delegated construction and assessment authority, and re-entry
conditions. It may point to accepted design and existing evidence carriers
rather than restating them. Ticket state, ticket prose, or an admitted execution
contract cannot widen that basis or substitute for the live-surface assessment
required by the protocol.

The reviewable transition may be carried by an existing ticket, commentary,
commit, qualification, or release-evidence surface. No new ticket state,
document type, review round, or approval ceremony is required. Ticket Method
carries selection and traceability; `SPEC_METHOD.md` owns the execution
semantics.


Source: [TICKET_METHOD.md — Condition-Based Closure And Reuse](../TICKET_METHOD.md#condition-based-closure-and-reuse); SHA256 `2cbdc039c0a9033cb541a8b63d90da11a35923ea89ebe2d3132ffa7ddfb84417`.

### Condition-Based Closure And Reuse

A work claim is complete only when every applicable declared obligation is
satisfied by valid evidence for its exact subject, basis and scope, all required
judgments and owner rulings are present and applicable, and no active
non-closure condition remains. A mandatory but unknown applicability or
insufficient-evidence result withholds the dependent claim; evidence presence
alone is not satisfaction. The existing owner decides any reserved acceptance.

Review evaluates these conditions; its occurrence is not the closing event.
Where applicable law requires no independent review or reserved acceptance,
the authorized Writer may record the satisfied bounded result in the existing
carrier without adding a ticket, Executive appointment, review or design-view
recreation solely to mark completion. This does not waive a condition that
actually applies, including sprint-close or design-method law.

An unchanged obligation reuses valid applicable evidence and recorded J/O.
A material counterexample, changed evidence or basis invalidates the affected
claim and its dependent results before further reliance. An unrelated
observation is retained as bounded repricing input; it does not reopen a
satisfied claim or expand work automatically. Closure recording preserves the
exact evaluated scope, satisfied conditions, evidence and remaining residuals.

### RF-005 Exact Basis And Coordinates

Every result binds its exact subject, basis, coordinates, and evidence scope.
A stale, advanced, ambiguous, or mismatched basis returns `invalid_basis` or
requires reactivation. Apparent equality does not substitute for declared
coordinate equality.
